object_keys: ascending UTF-8 byte order; duplicate keys reject
arrays: preserve input order except reference arrays, which use reference-encoding canonical order
numbers: shortest RFC 8785-compatible finite JSON representation; reject NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, and negative zero
strings: JSON escaping with no insignificant whitespace

domains.payload_digest: cowd.ownership.payload.v1\0 + canonical object with payload_digest removed
domains.section_digest: cowd.ownership.section.v1\0 + canonical section with section_digest removed
domains.reconciliation_digest: cowd.ownership.reconciliation.v1\0 + canonical reconciliation object with set_digest removed; typed arrays retained independently
domains.whole_snapshot_digest: cowd.ownership.snapshot.v1\0 + canonical snapshot with whole_snapshot_digest removed
domains.external_catalog_digest: cowd.ownership.external-catalog.v1\0 + canonical catalog with digest removed
